author: c4ooo
body:
The editor is so hard to navigate i posted it before i was done typing >.<
My idea is to have 3 of these rectangles radiating from the hub. The fourth will be curved, like a question mark. Together this will form a shape like the Blue Oyster Cult logo:

To of these shapes will face each other, with a giant ring around them, with the majority of the PVP taking place on the curved section of the question marks.
All together this will form something like this:

Any suggestion? I dont want there to only be one contact point between the two sides, but i dont think a huge ring around both teams is the best idea >_>
With only one contact point between the teams it will be a) boring and b) just a bigger version of Luar :P
